AI consulting services: scope your pilot before you buy

Compare discovery, integration and pilot deliverables from ten AI consultancies. Use a sample acceptance test to price the work your team actually needs.

Find a match for my project

Three AI consulting services to shortlist by deliverable

A finance director asking for an AI strategy and a support lead replacing an agent desktop can receive nearly identical proposals. Start with what your team needs to accept at the end of the engagement. These three cases give you different deliverables to put in a brief.

We chose these examples for the specific work documented in a client case or product guide. Client outcomes are provider-reported. AY Automate publishes this guide.

  1. Slalom · A contact-center rollout

    Slalom describes moving 180 Genie agents onto a new contact-center solution. That makes it a useful first interview for a support leader who owns routing, agent training and service continuity. Ask to see the release plan for the first queue and an example of an issue the operations team could fix after handover.

    Read the source from Slalom

  2. Capgemini · A shared automation service

    Capgemini describes establishing a global automation service with ZF. A buyer funding several teams can use that case to ask who decides which workflow gets built next. Request a backlog example with the estimated effort, business owner and sign-off for a completed automation.

    Read the source from Capgemini

  3. AY Automate · Document checks with exceptions

    AY Automate publishes a workforce compliance case involving document verification for festival crews. A coordinator buying a similar service should bring an expired document, an unreadable scan and a record that needs human review. Ask the team to show the outcome for all three before pricing a rollout.

    Read the source from AY Automate

What to ask before you buy

  1. For an assessment, ask for a prioritized backlog with an owner and a baseline for each opportunity.
  2. For a pilot, agree on a test dataset, an acceptance threshold and the decisions a human will retain.
  3. For a rollout, get a handover plan covering monitoring, recurring costs and incident response.

Workflow implementation

AY Automate

Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask for a pilot that takes one document from intake to a human-approved exception. Specify who labels the acceptance examples.

Source from AY Automate

Enterprise transformation

BCG

Combines strategy and applied AI. For a strategy purchase, request a sequenced opportunity list, one accountable sponsor per item and an explicit reason to decline the weakest item.

Source from BCG

Technology integration

IBM Consulting

Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Before funding integration, ask for a map of the source systems and a running test against one of your representative records.

Source from IBM Consulting

AI implementation

Slalom

Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Write down the smallest queue the team could launch. Request a cutover rehearsal and a training deliverable in the fixed scope.

Source from Slalom

Analytics and operating model

McKinsey QuantumBlack

Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Request an operating-model design that names the decision owner and shows how a disputed model output is reviewed.

Source from McKinsey QuantumBlack

Enterprise delivery

Accenture

Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Separate the statement of work into discovery, build and rollout. Mark which deliverable releases each payment.

Source from Accenture

Engineering and data

Deloitte

Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Specify which dataset must be usable at the end of engineering discovery. Ask for quality checks your engineer can repeat.

Source from Deloitte

Process automation

Capgemini

Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. For a shared process service, request a backlog intake exercise with two departments competing for the same delivery capacity.

Source from Capgemini

Workflow integration

WeAreBrain

Offers workflow automation and integration. If the service connects an ERP to another system, ask for one failed transaction to be replayed safely before acceptance.

Source from WeAreBrain

Operations workflows

Goodspeed

Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask for a working automation and a handover exercise. Price employee time spent learning the workflow as a buyer contribution.

Source from Goodspeed

How to compare prices

Request separate prices for discovery, implementation and ongoing support. Compare the cost of the first accepted workflow and the monthly cost to keep it running.

A worked example to review

IBM’s UHCW NHS Trust case describes working with Celonis and the trust to identify opportunities and pilot technology for productivity. For a discovery purchase, ask the consultant to show which finding changed the pilot scope and what evidence would stop the project before implementation.

Read the provider’s example

What should a paid discovery deliver?

Ask for a baseline, a process map, a data-access assessment and a short implementation estimate you can take to a second provider.
